name: app-green-travel-app-phone-on-green-velvet-sofa
title: Green Travel App on Velvet Sofa
whatItIs: A phone with a lime edge lying on a moss-green velvet sofa, showing a Dubai trip screen with an aerial photo header, a dark green details bar, essentials icons and a flight card, in matching greens.
whatItMeans: The UI matches the velvet, making the app feel part of a cosy material world.
techniques: Tonal match between the UI and the sofa
Dark green info bar with icons
Lime accent on the nav home button

vocabulary.definition: A scene whose colours match the UI.
A soft fabric surface used as a backdrop.
A strip showing dates, duration and guests.
